.defs{display:none}
.stepper{display:grid;gap:14px}
.stages{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.stages button{min-height:44px;min-width:44px;padding:6px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:#fff;font:inherit;font-size:.9rem;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink)}
.stages button[aria-current="step"]{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.stagebody{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
@media (max-width:760px){.stagebody{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.cell{background:var(--base-soft);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:.95rem}
.cell h4{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:.78rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--ink2)}
.why{font-size:.98rem;margin:0}
.nav2{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.nav2 button,.plain{min-height:44px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--accent);background:#fff;color:var(--accent);font:inherit;font-size:.95rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
.nav2 button:disabled{border-color:var(--line);color:#a3aab3;cursor:not-allowed}
table{border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.92rem;width:100%}
th,td{text-align:left;padding:6px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--grid);vertical-align:top}
td.num,th.num{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.tablewrap{overflow-x:auto}
.browser{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,5fr) minmax(0,7fr);gap:18px}
@media (max-width:860px){.browser{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.list{max-height:460px;overflow-y:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.list button{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;width:100%;min-height:44px;text-align:left;padding:8px 12px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--grid);background:#fff;font:inherit;font-size:.93rem;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink)}
.list button[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--accent-soft);box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 var(--accent)}
.list button span.v{color:var(--ink2);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.sbs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin:10px 0}
@media (max-width:560px){.sbs{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.pill{display:inline-block;font-size:.78rem;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--base-soft);color:var(--ink2);margin-right:4px}
.pill.ok{background:#e3f1e6;color:#1d6b33}.pill.bad{background:#fbe9e2;color:var(--warn)}
figure{margin:22px 0}
figure img{width:100%;height:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:#fff}
figcaption{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ink2);margin-top:8px;max-width:90ch}
.calc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:18px}
@media (max-width:760px){.calc{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.slrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:2px 10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px}
.slrow label{font-size:.92rem}
.slrow output{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-size:.92rem;min-width:5ch;text-align:right}
.slrow input{grid-column:1 / span 2;width:100%}
footer{padding:40px 0 60px;background:var(--panel)}
dl.gloss{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,14rem) minmax(0,1fr);gap:6px 18px;font-size:.95rem}
dl.gloss dt{font-weight:600}
dl.gloss dd{margin:0}
@media (max-width:640px){dl.gloss{grid-template-columns:1fr}dl.gloss dd{margin-bottom:8px}}
.limits li{margin-bottom:8px}
.sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<a class="skip" href="#main">Skip to main content</a>
<header class="hero">
  <div class="wrap">
    <p class="kicker">Interactive companion to the paper</p>
    <h1>Early co-occurrence network openness predicts cross-disciplinary concept breadth: evidence from 12,499 scientific concepts</h1>
    <p class="author">AI Inventor</p>
    <div class="links">
      <a class="btn primary" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them@fork/run_e4QYTG8fEPNh/paper.pdf">Read the paper (PDF)</a>
      <a class="btn" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them@fork/run_e4QYTG8fEPNh/report.pdf">Read the full research report</a>
      <a class="btn" href="https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them/tree/fork/run_e4QYTG8fEPNh">Code repository</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>
<nav class="sections" aria-label="Page sections">
  <ul>
    <li><a href="#finding">The finding</a></li>
    <li><a href="#how">How it works</a></li>
    <li><a href="#evidence">Explore the evidence</a></li>
    <li><a href="#try">Try it</a></li>
    <li><a href="#fails">Where it fails</a></li>
    <li><a href="#sources">Sources &amp; glossary</a></li>
  </ul>
</nav>

<main id="main">
<!-- ============ THE FINDING ============ -->
<section class="block" id="finding" aria-labelledby="h-finding">
<div class="wrap finding">
  <div class="prose">
    <p class="q">The question</p>
    <h2 id="h-finding">Can the shape of a new concept's first three years tell us how far it will travel?</h2>
    <p>Some scientific concepts stay in their home discipline; others cross into many fields within a few years. Simple popularity counts already explain much of that difference. The paper asks whether the structure of a concept's early <button class="term" data-term="cooc">co-occurrence network</button> adds anything beyond a five-feature popularity baseline, <button class="term" data-term="b5">B5</button>.</p>
    <p class="q">The answer</p>
    <p>Yes, a little, and with the same sign everywhere it was measured. Concepts whose early home-field neighbourhood keeps picking up new, community-spanning topic partners later reach more fields than B5 predicts. The <button class="term" data-term="openhome">OPEN<sub>home</sub></button> index has a pooled <button class="term" data-term="psp">partial Spearman</button> correlation with <button class="term" data-term="o2r">rarefied field breadth</button> of</p>
    <p class="bignum" id="bignum"></p>
    <p class="muted small" id="bignum-note"></p>
    <p>The effect is small. It is a descriptive pool, not a confirmation: five of the six bodies had their outcomes read in earlier analyses, and adding OPEN<sub>home</sub> to B5 gives no practical forecasting gain (+0.002 [−0.003, +0.008]).</p>
  </div>
  <div class="view" id="v-headline" aria-labelledby="h-head">
    <p class="q">Does it hold in every body of concepts?</p>
    <h3 id="h-head">OPEN<sub>home</sub> against breadth, body by body</h3>
    <div class="controls">
      <div role="radiogroup" aria-label="Indicator" class="seg" id="hd-feature">
        <button role="radio" aria-checked="true" data-v="OPEN_home">OPEN<sub>home</sub></button>
        <button role="radio" aria-checked="false" data-v="NOVCHURN_home">NOVCHURN<sub>home</sub></button>
      </div>
      <div role="radiogroup" aria-label="Control rung" class="seg" id="hd-rung">
        <button role="radio" aria-checked="false" data-v="R0">R0</button>
        <button role="radio" aria-checked="true" data-v="R2">R2</button>
        <button role="radio" aria-checked="false" data-v="R3">R3</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="small muted" id="hd-rung-note"></p>
    <div class="legend" aria-hidden="true">
      <span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--accent)"></span>non-selection body, 95% CI</span>
      <span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--base)"></span>selection body (not pooled)</span>
      <span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--band)"></span>placebo: 95th pct of |PSP| under shuffled outcomes (R2)</span>
      <span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--ink)"></span>DerSimonian–Laird pool</span>
    </div>
    <div class="chart" id="c-headline"></div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="t-headline" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>
</div>
</section>

<!-- ============ HOW IT WORKS ============ -->
<section class="block" id="how" aria-labelledby="h-how">
<div class="wrap">
  <p class="q">How does the index work?</p>
  <h2 id="h-how">One concept, followed through the method</h2>
  <p class="prose">The stepper walks the graphics processing unit (GPU), case pair 1 in the paper, from grounding to the pooled estimate. Every value shown is the one the run recorded for GPU; stage 4 recomputes OPEN<sub>home</sub> in your browser from the recorded components and the frozen constants.</p>
  <div class="view stepper" id="stepper" aria-labelledby="h-step" tabindex="-1">
    <h3 id="h-step" class="sr">Method stepper</h3>
    <div class="chart" id="c-pipeline" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <ol class="stages" id="stage-list" aria-label="Method stages"></ol>
    <div id="stage-panel"></div>
    <div class="nav2">
      <button id="st-prev" type="button">Previous</button>
      <button id="st-next" type="button">Next</button>
      <span class="small muted">Left and right arrow keys also move between stages.</span>
    </div>
    <p class="sr" aria-live="polite" id="st-live"></p>
    <p class="takeaway" id="t-step" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>
  <figure>
    <img src="figures/fig_overview_v0.jpg" alt="Flow diagram: the OpenAlex snapshot (476M works) is matched against 56,643 legacy concepts to give 12,499 grounded concepts; these are split into DEV 4,771, held-out 3,372, a 2010–2014 cohort of 4,356 and a fresh 2015–2017 cohort of 1,443; 53 indicators in six families are computed; RQ1 screens and validates them (7 confirmed, OPEN pooled +0.069) and RQ2 fits a conditional logit on 11,841 concepts (d0 = 0.322, verdict PARTIAL)." loading="lazy" width="3840" height="1648">
    <figcaption>Figure 1 of the paper. Overview of the study design, read left to right. The OpenAlex snapshot (blue; 476M works, 129.4M base works 1995–2022) is title-matched against 56,643 legacy concepts, and Aho–Corasick matching plus an LLM precision gate (teal) keeps 12,499 grounded concepts. The panel split (green) assigns these to a development set (DEV 4,771; CS, Eng, BGM, Med homes, onset 2003–2009), four held-out domain groups (3,372; PHYS, LIFEENV, SOC, MATHDEC) and a 2010–2014 onset cohort (4,356). A fresh 2015–2017 cohort (1,443; dashed box) comes from a separate scan. For each concept, 53 early indicators in six families (orange; A ego-network 27, E popularity 6, F disciplinary 3, FR frontier 7, G gateway 7, S co-author 3) are computed in the t<sub>0</sub> to t<sub>0</sub>+2 window. They are screened on DEV and validated on held-out groups (RQ1, top right): 7 frozen indicators are confirmed on held-out, and the pooled partial Spearman of the OPEN index is +0.069. Separately (lower arrow, bypassing the indicators), a conditional-logit entry model is fitted on an independent concept frame of 11,841 concepts (RQ2, bottom right). It gives d<sub>0</sub> = 0.322 for retained-frontier relatedness, and the pre-registered verdict is PARTIAL because persistence is confounded with volume.</figcaption>
  </figure>
  <figure>
    <img src="figures/fig_case_study_v0.png" alt="Three panels. Left: step lines of off-home fields entered and retained over eight years since onset; GPU rises to 11 entered and 8 retained, VAWT to 6 entered and 4 retained. Middle: GPU's early topic ego network with 34 topics in 8 colour-coded communities. Right: VAWT's network with 12 topics in one Engineering community." loading="lazy" width="1300" height="558">
    <figcaption>Figure 4 of the paper. Illustrative matched case-study pair (pair 1 of 7): graphics processing unit (GPU; onset t<sub>0</sub>=2008, high early-neighbourhood openness OPEN) versus vertical-axis wind turbine (VAWT; t<sub>0</sub>=2009, low OPEN). Both have an Engineering home field and are matched on early volume and growth. (a) Number of off-home venue fields each concept has ever entered (solid line, filled markers) and currently retains (dashed line, open markers) in each year from t<sub>0</sub> to t<sub>0</sub>+8; GPU is shown in black and VAWT in grey on a shared axis. (b, c) Topic co-occurrence ego networks over the first three years (t<sub>0</sub> to t<sub>0</sub>+2, all papers). The nodes are the concept's positive-PMI neighbour topics (the concept itself is not drawn), the edges are links between those topics in the topic backbone, node area scales with the number of the concept's papers carrying the topic, and colour gives the topic's Leiden community, named by the plurality OpenAlex field. GPU's neighbourhood has 34 topics in 8 communities (density 0.30). VAWT's has 12 topics in a single Engineering community (density 0.70). The pair illustrates the openness–breadth association and is not evidence for it. Note: the panels use all papers, while the stepper above uses the home-only build.</figcaption>
  </figure>
</div>
</section>

<!-- ============ EXPLORE THE EVIDENCE ============ -->
<section class="block" id="evidence" aria-labelledby="h-ev">
<div class="wrap">
  <p class="q">Explore the evidence</p>
  <h2 id="h-ev">Look at the concepts, then at where concepts go next</h2>

  <div class="view" id="v-browser" aria-labelledby="h-br">
    <p class="q">What does openness look like for one concept?</p>
    <h3 id="h-br">Concept browser: early neighbourhood, index, forecast and outcome</h3>
    <p class="small muted prose">7,748 concepts from the noise-control experiment (DEV, old held-out groups, 2010–14 and 2015–17 cohorts). Forecasts are the run's DEV-fitted OLS predictions of O<sub>2r</sub> (m = 50) from B5 alone and from B5 plus OPEN<sub>home</sub>. All of these bodies are selection or previously unsealed data.</p>
    <div class="controls">
      <label>Search <input type="search" id="br-q" placeholder="e.g. CRISPR, Zika" autocomplete="off"></label>
      <label>Body <select id="br-body">
        <option value="">All bodies</option><option value="DEV">DEV (selection)</option><option value="OLDHO">Held-out groups 2003–09</option><option value="COH1014">2010–14 cohort</option><option value="COH1517">2015–17 cohort</option></select></label>
      <label>Sort <select id="br-sort">
        <option value="open-desc">OPEN<sub>home</sub>, high to low</option><option value="open-asc">OPEN<sub>home</sub>, low to high</option><option value="surprise-desc">Breadth above B5 forecast</option><option value="surprise-asc">Breadth below B5 forecast</option><option value="name">Name A–Z</option></select></label>
      <label>Show <select id="br-filter">
        <option value="all">All concepts</option><option value="outcome">Only with an observed outcome</option><option value="miss-high">Misses: top-fifth OPEN, narrower than B5 forecast</option><option value="miss-low">Misses: bottom-fifth OPEN, broader than B5 forecast</option></select></label>
    </div>
    <p class="small muted" id="br-count" aria-live="polite"></p>
    <div class="browser">
      <ul class="list" id="br-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Concepts"></ul>
      <div id="br-detail" aria-live="polite"></div>
    </div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="t-browser" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>

  <div class="view" id="v-quint" aria-labelledby="h-qu">
    <p class="q">Do high-OPEN concepts beat their popularity forecast?</p>
    <h3 id="h-qu">Breadth minus B5 forecast, by fifth of OPEN<sub>home</sub></h3>
    <p class="small muted prose">Computed in the page from the browser's records: concepts with an observed outcome are split into fifths of OPEN<sub>home</sub> within the chosen body, and each bar is the mean of observed O<sub>2r</sub> minus the B5 forecast. This is a plain residual view, not the paper's partial Spearman, which also controls onset year and the R2 covariates.</p>
    <div class="controls">
      <div role="radiogroup" aria-label="Body" class="seg" id="qu-body">
        <button role="radio" aria-checked="true" data-v="">All</button>
        <button role="radio" aria-checked="false" data-v="DEV">DEV</button>
        <button role="radio" aria-checked="false" data-v="OLDHO">Held-out</button>
        <button role="radio" aria-checked="false" data-v="COH1014">2010–14</button>
        <button role="radio" aria-checked="false" data-v="COH1517">2015–17</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="legend" aria-hidden="true"><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--accent)"></span>mean observed − B5 forecast (fields, m = 50)</span><span><span class="sw" style="background:#6b737e;height:2px;vertical-align:4px"></span>zero = B5 forecast</span></div>
    <div class="chart" id="c-quint"></div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="t-quint" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>

  <div class="view" id="v-entry" aria-labelledby="h-en">
    <p class="q">Where does a concept go next?</p>
    <h3 id="h-en">Retained-frontier coefficient d<sub>0</sub> by unit</h3>
    <p class="small muted prose">A <button class="term" data-term="clogit">conditional logit</button> on concept-year risk sets asks whether a concept next enters fields related (by <button class="term" data-term="pmi">PMI</button>) to the off-home fields that currently <button class="term" data-term="retain">retain</button> it. <button class="term" data-term="d0">d<sub>0</sub></button> is the log-odds of entry per SD of that relatedness, at rung R3, after home relatedness, field size, entered density, gateway centrality, RCA density and volume density.</p>
    <fieldset class="controls" id="en-units"><legend>Units shown</legend></fieldset>
    <div class="legend" aria-hidden="true"><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--accent)"></span>held-out unit, 95% concept-bootstrap CI</span><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--base)"></span>DEV selection data</span><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--ink)"></span>pool</span></div>
    <div class="chart" id="c-entry"></div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="t-entry" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>

  <div class="view" id="v-strata" aria-labelledby="h-sb">
    <p class="q">What does the entry model see in one decision?</p>
    <h3 id="h-sb">Entry browser: one concept-year, every candidate field</h3>
    <p class="small muted prose">Each held-out risk set lists the fields a concept had not yet entered. The bars are the run's within-set choice probabilities from frozen DEV coefficients: the R2 baseline (grey) and R3 with retained-frontier relatedness (blue). The field actually entered that year is marked. The page embeds 30 risk sets per unit, drawn with a fixed seed from all 12,510 informative held-out sets.</p>
    <div class="controls">
      <label>Unit <select id="sb-unit"></select></label>
      <label>Risk set <select id="sb-set"></select></label>
      <label class="chk"><input type="checkbox" id="sb-flip"> Only sets where R3 ranks the entered field higher than R2</label>
    </div>
    <div class="legend" aria-hidden="true"><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--base)"></span>R2 baseline probability</span><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--accent)"></span>R3 retained-frontier probability</span></div>
    <div class="sbs" id="sb-sbs"></div>
    <div class="chart" id="c-strata"></div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="t-strata" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>
</div>
</section>

<!-- ============ TRY IT ============ -->
<section class="block" id="try" aria-labelledby="h-try">
<div class="wrap">
  <p class="q">Try it</p>
  <h2 id="h-try">Run the index yourself, and give the entry model more guesses</h2>

  <div class="view" id="v-calc" aria-labelledby="h-calc">
    <p class="q">Can I compute OPEN<sub>home</sub> myself?</p>
    <h3 id="h-calc">Live OPEN<sub>home</sub> calculator</h3>
    <p class="small muted prose">OPEN<sub>home</sub> is exact arithmetic: clip each component to its frozen bounds, z-score it with the frozen DEV mean and SD, flip the sign of ego density and edge persistence, and average the components that are defined. The calculator loads the concept selected in the browser; move a slider to see how the index responds. The percentile compares the result with all recorded OPEN<sub>home</sub> values.</p>
    <p class="small" id="calc-name"></p>
    <div class="calc">
      <div id="calc-sliders"></div>
      <div>
        <div class="legend" aria-hidden="true"><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--accent)"></span>signed z-score (adds openness)</span><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--warn)"></span>signed z-score (subtracts)</span></div>
        <div class="chart" id="c-calc"></div>
        <p id="calc-out" class="small" aria-live="polite"></p>
        <button class="plain" type="button" id="calc-reset">Reset to recorded values</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="t-calc" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>

  <div class="view" id="v-topk" aria-labelledby="h-tk">
    <p class="q">What if the model could name k candidate fields?</p>
    <h3 id="h-tk">Top-k hit rate of the entered field, R2 baseline versus R3</h3>
    <p class="small muted prose">For all 14,410 held-out entry events, the page ranks the entered field among its risk set under each model's recorded probabilities and counts how often it falls in the top k. Recomputed live over every event; ties count in the entered field's favour.</p>
    <div class="controls">
      <label for="tk-k">Guesses k</label>
      <input type="range" id="tk-k" min="1" max="10" step="1" value="3" aria-describedby="tk-kv">
      <output id="tk-kv" for="tk-k">3</output>
    </div>
    <div class="legend" aria-hidden="true"><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--base)"></span>R2 baseline</span><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--accent)"></span>R3 with retained frontier</span></div>
    <div class="chart" id="c-topk"></div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="t-topk" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>
</div>
</section>

<!-- ============ WHERE IT FAILS ============ -->
<section class="block" id="fails" aria-labelledby="h-fails">
<div class="wrap">
  <p class="q">Where it fails</p>
  <h2 id="h-fails">The tests the claims did not pass</h2>

  <div class="view" id="v-robust" aria-labelledby="h-rb">
    <p class="q">Does the entry result survive its own pre-registered checks?</p>
    <h3 id="h-rb">d<sub>0</sub> under robustness variants and under the tests it failed</h3>
    <div class="controls">
      <div role="tablist" aria-label="Test family" class="seg" id="rb-tabs">
        <button role="tab" aria-selected="true" data-v="fail" id="rb-tab-fail" aria-controls="c-robust">Failed tests</button>
        <button role="tab" aria-selected="false" data-v="dose" id="rb-tab-dose" aria-controls="c-robust">Dose by retention age</button>
        <button role="tab" aria-selected="false" data-v="robust" id="rb-tab-robust" aria-controls="c-robust">Robustness variants</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="legend" aria-hidden="true"><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--warn)"></span>test the verdict depends on</span><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--accent)"></span>estimate</span><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--accent);height:2px;vertical-align:4px"></span>primary held-out d<sub>0</sub></span></div>
    <div class="chart" id="c-robust" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="rb-tab-fail"></div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="t-robust" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>

  <div class="view" id="v-conf" aria-labelledby="h-cf">
    <p class="q">Is the openness signal temporal churn, or just a thin sample?</p>
    <h3 id="h-cf"><button class="term" data-term="novchurn">NOVCHURN</button> before and after noise controls</h3>
    <div class="controls">
      <label>Body <select id="cf-body"><option value="POOLED">Pooled</option><option value="DEV">DEV</option><option value="OLDHO">Held-out 2003–09</option><option value="COH1014">2010–14 cohort</option><option value="COH1517">2015–17 cohort</option></select></label>
    </div>
    <div class="legend" aria-hidden="true"><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--base)"></span>raw measure</span><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--accent)"></span>noise-controlled variant</span><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--warn)"></span>temporal-excess variant (unreliable)</span></div>
    <div class="chart" id="c-conf"></div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="t-conf" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>

  <div class="view" id="v-miss" aria-labelledby="h-ms">
    <p class="q">How often does openness point the wrong way for a single concept?</p>
    <h3 id="h-ms">Misses among the most and least open concepts</h3>
    <div class="tablewrap"><table id="ms-table"><caption class="sr">Misses by body</caption></table></div>
    <div class="controls" style="margin-top:10px">
      <button class="plain" type="button" id="ms-show-high">Show top-fifth misses in the browser</button>
      <button class="plain" type="button" id="ms-show-low">Show bottom-fifth misses in the browser</button>
    </div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="t-miss" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>

  <h3>What the paper does not show</h3>
  <ul class="prose limits">
    <li><strong>Not a forecasting tool.</strong> OPEN<sub>home</sub> adds no forecasting gain over B5 (+0.002 [−0.003, +0.008]). The association is modest.</li>
    <li><strong>Not confirmatory for most bodies.</strong> Held-out outcomes were previously unsealed by two earlier experiments, so the indicator-screen held-out results are robustness checks. Only the 2015–17 cohort was never used before.</li>
    <li><strong>Not temporal churn.</strong> The within-concept permutation null absorbs the year-to-year component (excess NOVCHURN +0.008 [−0.02, +0.03] against raw +0.116 [+0.09, +0.14]). The temporal-excess variants have split-half reliability of about 0.01–0.05, so temporal turnover is untested rather than refuted.</li>
    <li><strong>Not a within-concept mechanism.</strong> The closure test is null on DEV and opposite-signed on held-out fields (−0.079 [−0.146, −0.013]).</li>
    <li><strong>Home-only signal is marginal.</strong> On the fresh cohort the DerSimonian–Laird pool includes zero (+0.083 [−0.007, +0.173]); about half of the OPEN<sub>all</sub> signal is mechanical coupling with the outcome.</li>
    <li><strong>Retained frontier is PARTIAL.</strong> The volume-matched contrast is null, the coefficient reverses under minimum-conditional-probability proximity, and persistence and volume remain confounded.</li>
    <li><strong>Not causal.</strong> Early openness could reflect a concept's intrinsic generality, the diversity of the research community around it, or the breadth of the problems it addresses.</li>
    <li><strong>Vocabulary bias.</strong> The legacy concept vocabulary is survivor-selected; the vocabulary-free Frame N is small (636 concepts) with pre-unseal power of 0.47.</li>
  </ul>
</div>
</section>
</main>

<div class="tip" id="tip" role="tooltip" hidden></div>
<div class="defs" id="defs"></div>
<svg id="measure" aria-hidden="true" style="position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:0;width:10px;height:10px"></svg>

<!--DATA_SCRIPTS-->

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
const D = id => JSON.parse(document.getElementById(id).textContent);
const EV = D("data-evidence"), EN = D("data-entry"), EVT = D("data-events"), ST = D("data-strata"),
      CO = D("data-concepts"), K = D("data-constants"), CF = D("data-confound"), CASE = D("data-case");
const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
function el(tag, attrs, parent){ const e = document.createElementNS(NS, tag); for (const k in attrs) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); if (parent) parent.appendChild(e); return e; }
function txt(parent, x, y, s, attrs){ const t = el("text", Object.assign({x:x, y:y}, attrs || {}), parent); t.textContent = s; return t; }
function esc(s){ return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c])); }
function fx(x, d, sign){ if (x === null || x === undefined || isNaN(x)) return "n/a"; d = d === undefined ? 3 : d; const p = Math.pow(10, d); const v = Math.round(x * p) / p; const s = Math.abs(v).toFixed(d); if (v < 0) return "−" + s; return (sign && v > 0 ? "+" : "") + s; }
function ci(lo, hi, d, sign){ return "[" + fx(lo, d, sign) + ", " + fx(hi, d, sign) + "]"; }
function pct(x, d){ return (x * 100).toFixed(d === undefined ? 1 : d) + "%"; }
const MS = document.getElementById("measure");
function tw(s, cls){ const t = txt(MS, 0, 20, s, {"class": cls}); const w = t.getComputedTextLength(); t.remove(); return w; }
const reduce = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

/* ---------- chart tooltip ---------- */
const tip = document.getElementById("tip");
let tipOwner = null;
function showTip(html, target){
  tip.innerHTML = html; tip.hidden = false; tipOwner = target;
  const r = target.getBoundingClientRect(), tr = tip.getBoundingClientRect();
  let x = r.left + window.scrollX + r.width / 2 - tr.width / 2;
  x = Math.max(8 + window.scrollX, Math.min(x, window.scrollX + document.documentElement.clientWidth - tr.width - 8));
  let y = r.top + window.scrollY - tr.height - 8;
  if (y < window.scrollY + 4) y = r.bottom + window.scrollY + 8;
  tip.style.left = x + "px"; tip.style.top = y + "px";
}
function hideTip(){ tip.hidden = true; tipOwner = null; }
function bindMark(g, html, label){
  g.setAttribute("tabindex", "0"); g.setAttribute("role", "img"); g.setAttribute("aria-label", label); g.classList.add("mark");
  const on = () => showTip(html, g);
  g.addEventListener("mouseenter", on); g.addEventListener("focus", on); g.addEventListener("click", e => { e.stopPropagation(); on(); });
  g.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => { if (tipOwner === g) hideTip(); });
  g.addEventListener("blur", () => { if (tipOwner === g) hideTip(); });
}
document.addEventListener("click", () => { if (tipOwner && tipOwner.classList && tipOwner.classList.contains("mark")) hideTip(); });

/* ---------- scales ---------- */
function niceTicks(lo, hi, n){
  const span = hi - lo, raw = span / Math.max(1, n), mag = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(raw)));
  const step = [1, 2, 2.5, 5, 10].map(m => m * mag).find(s => span / s <= n) || 10 * mag;
  const out = []; for (let v = Math.ceil(lo / step - 1e-9) * step; v <= hi + 1e-9; v += step) out.push(Math.round(v / step) * step);
  return {ticks: out, step: step};
}
function tickFmt(v, step){ const d = step >= 1 ? 0 : step >= 0.1 ? 1 : step >= 0.01 ? 2 : 3; return fx(v, d); }

/* ---------- forest chart ---------- */
function forest(box, o){
  box.innerHTML = "";
  const W = Math.max(300, box.clientWidth), rowH = 34, top = 8;
  const rows = o.rows;
  const labW = Math.min(W * 0.46, Math.max.apply(null, rows.map(r => tw(r.label, "rowlab" + (r.kind === "pool" ? " pool" : "")))) + 12);
  const showVals = o.values && W >= 620;
  const valW = showVals ? Math.max.apply(null, rows.map(r => tw(r.valText || "", "val"))) + 16 : 0;
  const x0 = labW + 10, x1 = W - valW - 14;
  let lo = Math.min(0, ...rows.map(r => r.lo !== undefined && r.lo !== null ? r.lo : r.est), ...rows.map(r => r.band ? -r.band : 0));
  let hi = Math.max(0, ...rows.map(r => r.hi !== undefined && r.hi !== null ? r.hi : r.est), ...rows.map(r => r.band || 0));
  const pad = (hi - lo) * 0.06; lo -= pad; hi += pad;
  const nt = niceTicks(lo, hi, Math.max(3, Math.floor((x1 - x0) / 70)));
  lo = Math.min(lo, nt.ticks[0]); hi = Math.max(hi, nt.ticks[nt.ticks.length - 1]);
  const X = v => x0 + (v - lo) / (hi - lo) * (x1 - x0);
  const H = top + rows.length * rowH + 58;
  const svg = el("svg", {viewBox: "0 0 " + W + " " + H, width: W, height: H, role: "group", "aria-label": o.aria}, box);
  nt.ticks.forEach(t => { el("line", {x1: X(t), x2: X(t), y1: top, y2: top + rows.length * rowH, "class": "grid"}, svg); txt(svg, X(t), top + rows.length * rowH + 18, tickFmt(t, nt.step), {"class": "tick", "text-anchor": "middle"}); });
  el("line", {x1: X(0), x2: X(0), y1: top, y2: top + rows.length * rowH, "class": "zero"}, svg);
  if (o.ref !== undefined) el("line", {x1: X(o.ref), x2: X(o.ref), y1: top, y2: top + rows.length * rowH, "class": "ref"}, svg);
  txt(svg, (x0 + x1) / 2, top + rows.length * rowH + 42, o.xTitle, {"class": "axtitle", "text-anchor": "middle"});
  rows.forEach((r, i) => {
    const y = top + i * rowH + rowH / 2;
    if (r.sepAbove) el("line", {x1: 0, x2: W, y1: y - rowH / 2, y2: y - rowH / 2, stroke: "#c9ced4"}, svg);
    txt(svg, labW, y + 4.5, r.label, {"class": "rowlab" + (r.kind === "pool" ? " pool" : r.kind === "sel" ? " sel" : ""), "text-anchor": "end"});
    const g = el("g", {}, svg);
    el("rect", {x: x0 - 4, y: y - rowH / 2 + 2, width: x1 - x0 + 8, height: rowH - 4, rx: 4, "class": "hit"}, g);
    if (r.band) el("rect", {x: X(-r.band), y: y - 9, width: X(r.band) - X(-r.band), height: 18, fill: "var(--band)"}, g);
    const col = r.color || (r.kind === "sel" ? "var(--base)" : r.kind === "pool" ? "var(--ink)" : "var(--accent)");
    if (r.lo !== undefined && r.lo !== null && r.kind !== "pool") el("line", {x1: X(r.lo), x2: X(r.hi), y1: y, y2: y, stroke: col, "stroke-width": 2.5}, g);
    if (r.kind === "pool" && r.lo !== null && r.lo !== undefined) el("polygon", {points: [X(r.lo) + "," + y, X(r.est) + "," + (y - 9), X(r.hi) + "," + y, X(r.est) + "," + (y + 9)].join(" "), fill: col}, g);
    else el(r.shape === "circle" ? "circle" : "rect", r.shape === "circle" ? {cx: X(r.est), cy: y, r: 6, fill: col} : {x: X(r.est) - 6, y: y - 6, width: 12, height: 12, fill: col}, g);
    if (showVals && r.valText) txt(svg, W - valW + 6, y + 4.5, r.valText, {"class": "val"});
    bindMark(g, r.tip, r.aria || r.label + ": " + (r.valText || fx(r.est)));
  });
  return svg;
}

/* ---------- horizontal grouped bars ---------- */
function hbars(box, o){
  box.innerHTML = "";
  const W = Math.max(300, box.clientWidth), barH = o.barH || 14, gap = 3, groupPad = 12;
  const cats = o.cats, nser = Math.max.apply(null, cats.map(c => c.vals.length));
  const groupH = nser * barH + (nser - 1) * gap + groupPad;
  const labW = Math.min(W * 0.48, Math.max.apply(null, cats.map(c => tw(c.label, "rowlab" + (c.bold ? " pool" : "")))) + 12);
  const valW = Math.max.apply(null, cats.map(c => Math.max.apply(null, c.vals.map(v => tw(v.text, "val"))))) + 8;
  const x0 = labW + 8, x1 = W - valW - 8, top = 6;
  let lo = o.domain ? o.domain[0] : Math.min(0, ...cats.flatMap(c => c.vals.map(v => v.v)));
  let hi = o.domain ? o.domain[1] : Math.max(0, ...cats.flatMap(c => c.vals.map(v => v.v)));
  if (hi === lo) hi = lo + 1;
  const nt = niceTicks(lo, hi, Math.max(3, Math.floor((x1 - x0) / 70)));
  if (!o.domain){ lo = Math.min(lo, nt.ticks[0]); hi = Math.max(hi, nt.ticks[nt.ticks.length - 1]); }
  const X = v => x0 + (v - lo) / (hi - lo) * (x1 - x0);
  const plotH = cats.length * groupH, H = top + plotH + 52;
  const svg = el("svg", {viewBox: "0 0 " + W + " " + H, width: W, height: H, role: "group", "aria-label": o.aria}, box);
  nt.ticks.forEach(t => { el("line", {x1: X(t), x2: X(t), y1: top, y2: top + plotH, "class": "grid"}, svg); txt(svg, X(t), top + plotH + 18, o.tickFmt ? o.tickFmt(t) : tickFmt(t, nt.step), {"class": "tick", "text-anchor": "middle"}); });
  el("line", {x1: X(0), x2: X(0), y1: top, y2: top + plotH, stroke: "#6b737e"}, svg);
  txt(svg, (x0 + x1) / 2, top + plotH + 42, o.xTitle, {"class": "axtitle", "text-anchor": "middle"});
  cats.forEach((c, i) => {
    const gy = top + i * groupH + groupPad / 2;
    txt(svg, labW, gy + (nser * barH + (nser - 1) * gap) / 2 + 4.5, c.label, {"class": "rowlab" + (c.bold ? " pool" : ""), "text-anchor": "end"});
    c.vals.forEach((v, j) => {
      const y = gy + j * (barH + gap);
      const g = el("g", {}, svg);
      el("rect", {x: 0, y: y - 1, width: W, height: barH + 2, "class": "hit"}, g);
      const a = X(Math.min(0, v.v)), b = X(Math.max(0, v.v));
      el("rect", {x: a, y: y, width: Math.max(1, b - a), height: barH, fill: v.color, rx: 2}, g);
      txt(svg, (v.v >= 0 ? b + 4 : Math.max(x0, a) - 4), y + barH - 3, v.text, {"class": "val", "text-anchor": v.v >= 0 ? "start" : "end"});
      bindMark(g, v.tip, v.aria);
    });
  });
  return svg;
}

/* ---------- ARIA radio/tab groups ---------- */
function radioGroup(root, onChange, attr){
  attr = attr || "aria-checked";
  const btns = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll("button"));
  function set(b, focus){ btns.forEach(x => { x.setAttribute(attr, x === b ? "true" : "false"); x.tabIndex = x === b ? 0 : -1; }); if (focus) b.focus(); onChange(b.dataset.v, b); }
  btns.forEach(b => { b.type = "button"; b.tabIndex = b.getAttribute(attr) === "true" ? 0 : -1;
    b.addEventListener("click", () => set(b));
    b.addEventListener("keydown", e => { const i = btns.indexOf(b); let n = null;
      if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "ArrowDown") n = btns[(i + 1) % btns.length];
      if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowUp") n = btns[(i - 1 + btns.length) % btns.length];
      if (n){ e.preventDefault(); set(n, true); } });
  });
  return {value: () => btns.find(b => b.getAttribute(attr) === "true").dataset.v};
}

/* ================= HEADLINE ================= */
const hd = {feature: "OPEN_home", rung: "R2"};
const BODY_ORDER = ["B2_PHYS", "B2_LIFEENV", "B2_SOC", "B2_MATHDEC", "B3_EXP5_COHORT_2010_14", "B4_COHORT_2015_17", "B1_DEV"];
function drawHeadline(){
  const pool = EV.pools[hd.feature + "|" + hd.rung];
  const rowsSrc = BODY_ORDER.map(b => EV.rows.find(r => r.body === b && r.feature === hd.feature)).filter(Boolean);
  const inPool = b => pool && pool.bodies.indexOf(b) >= 0;
  const main = rowsSrc.filter(r => inPool(r.body)), sel = rowsSrc.filter(r => !inPool(r.body));
  const rows = [];
  const featLab = hd.feature === "OPEN_home" ? "OPEN_home" : "NOVCHURN_home";
  function mk(r, kind){
    const c = r[hd.rung];
    const band = hd.rung === "R2" ? r.placebo_p95 : null;
    return {label: r.label + " (n = " + c.n.toLocaleString("en-US") + ")", est: c.psp, lo: c.lo, hi: c.hi, kind: kind, band: band,
      valText: fx(c.psp, 3, true) + " " + ci(c.lo, c.hi, 3, true),
      tip: "<strong>" + esc(r.label) + "</strong><br>" + featLab + " at " + hd.rung + ": PSP " + fx(c.psp, 3, true) + " " + ci(c.lo, c.hi, 3, true) + "<br>n = " + c.n.toLocaleString("en-US") + " concepts; status: " + esc(r.status) + (band ? "<br>placebo 95th pct |PSP|: " + fx(band, 3) : "")};
  }
  main.forEach(r => rows.push(mk(r, "body")));
  if (pool) rows.push({label: "DL pool, " + pool.k + " bodies", est: pool.est, lo: pool.lo, hi: pool.hi, kind: "pool", sepAbove: true,
      valText: fx(pool.est, 3, true) + " " + ci(pool.lo, pool.hi, 3, true),
      tip: "<strong>DerSimonian–Laird pool</strong><br>" + fx(pool.est, 3, true) + " " + ci(pool.lo, pool.hi, 3, true) + "<br>I² = " + fx(pool.I2, 2) + "; sign agreement " + pool.sign});
  sel.forEach((r, i) => { const m = mk(r, "sel"); if (i === 0) m.sepAbove = true; rows.push(m); });
  forest($("#c-headline"), {rows: rows, values: true, ref: pool ? pool.est : undefined, xTitle: "Partial Spearman with O₂r (m = 50), given " + hd.rung + " controls", aria: "Forest plot of " + featLab + " partial Spearman by body"});
  const nAbove = main.filter(r => r[hd.rung].lo > 0).length;
  const nPos = main.filter(r => r[hd.rung].psp > 0).length;
  let s = featLab.replace("_home", " home") + " at rung " + hd.rung + ": the pool over " + (pool ? pool.k : main.length) + " non-selection bodies is " + fx(pool.est, 3, true) + " " + ci(pool.lo, pool.hi, 3, true) + ", I² = " + fx(pool.I2, 2) + ". " + nPos + " of " + main.length + " bodies are positive, but only " + nAbove + " has a CI above zero on its own" + (nAbove === 1 ? "" : "") + ".";
  s = s.replace("only " + nAbove + " has", nAbove === 1 ? "only 1 has" : "only " + nAbove + " have");
  if (hd.rung === "R2"){ const beat = main.filter(r => r.R2.psp > r.placebo_p95).length; s += " " + beat + " of " + main.length + " estimates exceed their body's shuffled-outcome placebo band."; }
  if (pool && pool.sel !== null) s += " The selection body is " + fx(pool.shrink, 2) + "× the pool.";
  $("#t-headline").textContent = s;
  $("#hd-rung-note").textContent = {R0: "R0: controls for the B5 baseline only.", R2: "R2 (primary): B5 plus onset year, contact reach, concept type, a generic-concept flag and concept level.", R3: "R3: R2 plus the pre-onset footprint."}[hd.rung] + (hd.feature === "NOVCHURN_home" ? " NOVCHURN was chosen on the 2015–17 cohort, so that body is shown as selection data and the pool has five bodies." : "");
}
radioGroup($("#hd-feature"), v => { hd.feature = v; drawHeadline(); });
radioGroup($("#hd-rung"), v => { hd.rung = v; drawHeadline(); });
(function(){ const p = EV.pools["OPEN_home|R2"];
  $("#bignum").innerHTML = fx(p.est, 3, true) + " <small>" + ci(p.lo, p.hi, 3, true) + "</small>";
  $("#bignum-note").textContent = "DerSimonian–Laird pool over " + p.k + " non-selection bodies at rung R2, I² = " + fx(p.I2, 0) + ", " + p.sign + " positive. The development set, where the index was chosen, gives " + fx(p.sel, 3, true) + ", " + fx(p.shrink, 2) + "× the pool.";
})();

/* ================= CONCEPTS ================= */
const C = CO.cols, ci_ = n => C.indexOf(n);
const I = {name: ci_("name"), body: ci_("body"), agroup: ci_("agroup"), t0: ci_("t0"), nh: ci_("n_home_early"), open: ci_("OPEN_home"), y: ci_("O2r_m50"), b5: ci_("pred_B5"), b5o: ci_("pred_B5_OPEN")};
const COMPS = [
  {k: "new_edge_rate", col: "new_edge_rate", lab: "New edge rate", term: "ner"},
  {k: "n_comm_W3", col: "n_comm", lab: "Communities reached", term: "ncomm"},
  {k: "participation", col: "participation", lab: "Participation coefficient", term: "part"},
  {k: "NOV_res", col: "NOV_res", lab: "Novelty residual NOV_res", term: "novres"},
  {k: "ego_density_W3", col: "ego_density", lab: "Ego density", term: "egod"},
  {k: "edge_persistence", col: "edge_persistence", lab: "Edge persistence", term: "pers"}];
COMPS.forEach(c => c.i = ci_(c.col));
const BODY_LAB = {DEV: "DEV (selection)", OLDHO: "Held-out 2003–09", COH1014: "2010–14 cohort", COH1517: "2015–17 cohort"};
const ROWS = CO.rows.map((r, idx) => ({r: r, idx: idx}));
const openVals = ROWS.map(o => o.r[I.open]).filter(v => v !== null).sort((a, b) => a - b);
function pctRank(v){ let lo = 0, hi = openVals.length; while (lo < hi){ const m = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (openVals[m] < v) lo = m + 1; else hi = m; } return lo / openVals.length; }
function zOf(c, v){ const k = K[c.k]; const cl = Math.min(Math.max(v, k.lo), k.hi); return k.sign * (cl - k.mu) / k.sd; }
function openOf(vals){ const zs = []; COMPS.forEach((c, j) => { if (vals[j] !== null && vals[j] !== undefined) zs.push(zOf(c, vals[j])); }); return zs.length ? zs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / zs.length : null; }
const hasY = r => r[I.y] !== null && r[I.b5] !== null && r[I.open] !== null;
// fifths of OPEN within body (for misses)
function quintCuts(rows){ const v = rows.map(r => r[I.open]).sort((a, b) => a - b); return [0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8].map(q => v[Math.floor(q * (v.length - 1))]); }
const cutsByBody = {};
["", "DEV", "OLDHO", "COH1014", "COH1517"].forEach(b => { cutsByBody[b] = quintCuts(CO.rows.filter(r => hasY(r) && (!b || r[I.body] === b))); });
function isMissHigh(r){ const c = cutsByBody[r[I.body]]; return hasY(r) && r[I.open] >= c[3] && r[I.y] < r[I.b5]; }
function isMissLow(r){ const c = cutsByBody[r[I.body]]; return hasY(r) && r[I.open] < c[0] && r[I.y] > r[I.b5]; }

const br = {sel: ROWS.findIndex(o => o.r[I.name] === "Graphics processing unit")};
function filtered(){
  const q = $("#br-q").value.trim().toLowerCase(), body = $("#br-body").value, f = $("#br-filter").value, sort = $("#br-sort").value;
  let out = ROWS.filter(o => (!body || o.r[I.body] === body) && (!q || o.r[I.name].toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0) && o.r[I.open] !== null);
  if (f === "outcome") out = out.filter(o => hasY(o.r));
  if (f === "miss-high") out = out.filter(o => isMissHigh(o.r));
  if (f === "miss-low") out = out.filter(o => isMissLow(o.r));
  const sur = o => hasY(o.r) ? o.r[I.y] - o.r[I.b5] : null;
  const cmp = {"open-desc": (a, b) => b.r[I.open] - a.r[I.open], "open-asc": (a, b) => a.r[I.open] - b.r[I.open], "name": (a, b) => a.r[I.name].localeCompare(b.r[I.name]),
    "surprise-desc": (a, b) => (sur(b) === null ? -1e9 : sur(b)) - (sur(a) === null ? -1e9 : sur(a)), "surprise-asc": (a, b) => (sur(a) === null ? 1e9 : sur(a)) - (sur(b) === null ? 1e9 : sur(b))}[sort];
  return out.slice().sort(cmp);
}
function drawList(){
  const list = filtered(), ul = $("#br-list"); ul.innerHTML = "";
  const show = list.slice(0, 150);
  if (show.length && !show.some(o => o.idx === br.sel)) br.sel = show[0].idx;
  show.forEach(o => {
    const li = document.createElement("li"); li.setAttribute("role", "none");
    const b = document.createElement("button"); b.type = "button"; b.setAttribute("role", "option"); b.dataset.idx = o.idx;
    b.setAttribute("aria-selected", o.idx === br.sel ? "true" : "false");
    b.innerHTML = "<span>" + esc(o.r[I.name]) + " <span class='muted small'>" + o.r[I.t0] + "</span></span><span class='v'>OPEN " + fx(o.r[I.open], 2, true) + "</span>";
    b.addEventListener("click", () => { br.sel = o.idx; ul.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(x => x.setAttribute("aria-selected", x === b ? "true" : "false")); drawDetail(); loadCalc(); });
    b.addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "ArrowUp"){ e.preventDefault(); const sib = e.key === "ArrowDown" ? li.nextElementSibling : li.previousElementSibling; if (sib){ const nb = sib.querySelector("button"); nb.focus(); nb.click(); } } });
    li.appendChild(b); ul.appendChild(li);
  });
  $("#br-count").textContent = list.length.toLocaleString("en-US") + " concepts match" + (list.length > 150 ? "; the first 150 are listed, refine the search to see others." : ".");
  const wy = list.filter(o => hasY(o.r));
  if (wy.length >= 10){
    const sorted = wy.slice().sort((a, b) => a.r[I.open] - b.r[I.open]); const n5 = Math.floor(sorted.length / 5);
    const m = arr => arr.reduce((s, o) => s + o.r[I.y] - o.r[I.b5], 0) / arr.length;
    $("#t-browser").textContent = "Of the " + wy.length.toLocaleString("en-US") + " matching concepts with an observed outcome, the most open fifth lands " + fx(m(sorted.slice(-n5)), 2, true) + " fields from its B5 forecast on average and the least open fifth " + fx(m(sorted.slice(0, n5)), 2, true) + ". Individual concepts scatter widely around both.";
  } else $("#t-browser").textContent = "Fewer than 10 matching concepts have an observed outcome, too few to compare the most and least open.";
  drawDetail();
}
function drawDetail(){
  const box = $("#br-detail"); const o = ROWS[br.sel]; if (!o){ box.innerHTML = "<p class='muted'>No concept matches.</p>"; return; }
  const r = o.r, p = pctRank(r[I.open]);
  let h = "<h4 style='margin:0 0 4px;font-size:1.1rem'>" + esc(r[I.name]) + "</h4><p class='small muted' style='margin:0 0 8px'><span class='pill'>" + esc(BODY_LAB[r[I.body]]) + "</span><span class='pill'>" + esc(r[I.agroup]) + "</span> onset t<sub>0</sub> = " + r[I.t0] + ", " + r[I.nh].toLocaleString("en-US") + " home-field papers in t<sub>0</sub>..t<sub>0</sub>+2</p>";
  h += "<div class='sbs'><div class='cell'><h4>Input: early home network</h4>" + COMPS.map(c => esc(c.lab) + ": <strong>" + (r[c.i] === null ? "undefined" : fx(r[c.i], 3)) + "</strong>").join("<br>") + "</div>";
  h += "<div class='cell'><h4>Method output</h4>OPEN<sub>home</sub> = <strong>" + fx(r[I.open], 3, true) + "</strong><br>" + pct(p, 0) + " percentile of 7,748 concepts" + "<br><span class='small muted'>recomputed here: " + fx(openOf(COMPS.map(c => r[c.i])), 3, true) + "</span></div>";
  h += "<div class='cell'><h4>Forecast vs outcome</h4>" + (hasY(r) ? "B5 forecast: <strong>" + fx(r[I.b5], 2) + "</strong><br>B5 + OPEN: <strong>" + fx(r[I.b5o], 2) + "</strong><br>Observed O<sub>2r</sub>: <strong>" + fx(r[I.y], 2) + "</strong>" : "Outcome not observed (window incomplete or fewer than 50 papers); B5 forecast " + fx(r[I.b5], 2)) + "</div></div>";
  box.innerHTML = h;
  if (hasY(r)){
    const cdiv = document.createElement("div"); cdiv.className = "chart"; box.appendChild(cdiv);
    const vals = [["B5 forecast", r[I.b5], "var(--base)"], ["B5 + OPEN forecast", r[I.b5o], "#5c8fd6"], ["Observed breadth", r[I.y], "var(--accent)"]];
    hbars(cdiv, {cats: vals.map(v => ({label: v[0], vals: [{v: v[1], text: fx(v[1], 2), color: v[2], tip: esc(v[0]) + ": " + fx(v[1], 3) + " fields", aria: v[0] + " " + fx(v[1], 2)}]})), xTitle: "Expected distinct venue fields in 50 papers, t₀+6..t₀+8", barH: 16, aria: "Forecasts and outcome for " + r[I.name], domain: [0, Math.max(10, Math.ceil(Math.max(r[I.b5], r[I.b5o], r[I.y]) + 1))]});
  }
}
["#br-q", "#br-body", "#br-sort", "#br-filter"].forEach(s => $(s).addEventListener(s === "#br-q" ? "input" : "change", drawList));

/* ---------- fifths view ---------- */
let quBody = "";
function drawQuint(){
  const rows = CO.rows.filter(r => hasY(r) && (!quBody || r[I.body] === quBody)).sort((a, b) => a[I.open] - b[I.open]);
  const n = rows.length, cats = [];
  const names = ["1st fifth (least open)", "2nd fifth", "3rd fifth", "4th fifth", "5th fifth (most open)"];
  const means = [];
  for (let q = 0; q < 5; q++){
    const part = rows.slice(Math.floor(q * n / 5), Math.floor((q + 1) * n / 5));
    const m = part.reduce((s, r) => s + r[I.y] - r[I.b5], 0) / part.length; means.push(m);
    const mo = part.reduce((s, r) => s + r[I.open], 0) / part.length;
    cats.push({label: names[q], vals: [{v: m, text: fx(m, 2, true), color: m >= 0 ? "var(--accent)" : "var(--base)", tip: "<strong>" + names[q] + "</strong><br>n = " + part.length + " concepts, mean OPEN " + fx(mo, 2, true) + "<br>mean observed − B5 forecast: " + fx(m, 3, true) + " fields", aria: names[q] + ": " + fx(m, 2, true) + " fields, n " + part.length}]});
  }
  hbars($("#c-quint"), {cats: cats, xTitle: "Mean observed O₂r − B5 forecast (fields)", barH: 20, aria: "Mean residual breadth by fifth of OPEN"});
  $("#t-quint").textContent = (quBody ? BODY_LAB[quBody] : "All bodies") + " (" + n.toLocaleString("en-US") + " concepts): the most open fifth lands " + fx(means[4], 2, true) + " fields from its B5 forecast, the least open fifth " + fx(means[0], 2, true) + (means[4] > means[0] ? ", a gap of " + fx(means[4] - means[0], 2) + " fields in the direction the paper reports." : ", so in this body the plain residual does not order the fifths the way the paper's pooled estimate does.");
}
radioGroup($("#qu-body"), v => { quBody = v; drawQuint(); });

/* ================= ENTRY FOREST ================= */
const enShow = {};
EN.units.forEach(u => { enShow[u.id] = true;
  const lab = document.createElement("label"); lab.className = "chk";
  lab.innerHTML = "<input type='checkbox' checked data-u='" + u.id + "'> " + esc(u.label);
  $("#en-units").appendChild(lab);
  lab.querySelector("input").addEventListener("change", e => { enShow[u.id] = e.target.checked; drawEntry(); });
});
function drawEntry(){
  const rows = [];
  const us = EN.units.filter(u => enShow[u.id]);
  us.filter(u => u.kind !== "dev").forEach(u => rows.push({label: u.label + " (n = " + u.n.toLocaleString("en-US") + ")", est: u.d0, lo: u.lo, hi: u.hi, kind: "body", shape: "circle",
    valText: fx(u.d0, 3) + " " + ci(u.lo, u.hi, 3), tip: "<strong>" + esc(u.label) + "</strong><br>d₀ = " + fx(u.d0, 3) + " " + ci(u.lo, u.hi, 3) + "<br>" + u.n.toLocaleString("en-US") + " concepts, " + (u.events || "").toLocaleString("en-US") + " entry events<br>within-set AUC R2 " + fx(u.auc2, 3) + " → R3 " + fx(u.auc3, 3)}));
  const P = EN.pooled, L = EN.dl;
  rows.push({label: "Held-out pooled (R3)", est: P.est, lo: P.lo, hi: P.hi, kind: "pool", sepAbove: true, valText: fx(P.est, 3) + " " + ci(P.lo, P.hi, 3),
    tip: "<strong>Held-out pooled fit</strong><br>d₀ = " + fx(P.est, 3) + " " + ci(P.lo, P.hi, 3) + "<br>LR (R3 vs R2) = " + fx(P.LR, 1) + "; " + P.events.toLocaleString("en-US") + " events in " + P.strata.toLocaleString("en-US") + " informative strata"});
  rows.push({label: "DL pool, 4 held-out groups", est: L.est, lo: L.lo, hi: L.hi, kind: "pool", valText: fx(L.est, 3) + " " + ci(L.lo, L.hi, 3) + ", I² = " + fx(L.I2, 2),
    tip: "<strong>DerSimonian–Laird pool</strong><br>" + fx(L.est, 3) + " " + ci(L.lo, L.hi, 3) + "<br>I² = " + fx(L.I2, 2) + " (high heterogeneity)"});
  us.filter(u => u.kind === "dev").forEach((u, i) => rows.push({label: u.label + " (n = " + u.n.toLocaleString("en-US") + ")", est: u.d0, lo: u.lo, hi: u.hi, kind: "sel", shape: "circle", sepAbove: true,
    valText: fx(u.d0, 3) + " " + ci(u.lo, u.hi, 3), tip: "<strong>DEV, selection data</strong><br>d₀ = " + fx(u.d0, 3) + " " + ci(u.lo, u.hi, 3)}));
  forest($("#c-entry"), {rows: rows, values: true, xTitle: "d₀: log-odds of entry per SD of retained-field relatedness", aria: "Forest plot of d0 by unit"});
  const ho = us.filter(u => u.kind === "heldout");
  const pos = ho.filter(u => u.lo > 0);
  $("#t-entry").textContent = ho.length ? (pos.length + " of " + ho.length + " selected held-out groups have a CI above zero" + (pos.length ? " (" + pos.map(u => u.label + " " + fx(u.d0, 3)).join(", ") + ")" : "") + ". " + (ho.some(u => u.id === "MATHDEC") ? "Math & Decision (n = 165, excluded as underpowered before the freeze) is null. " : "") + "Pooled over held-out concepts d₀ = " + fx(P.est, 3) + " " + ci(P.lo, P.hi, 3) + "; the DerSimonian–Laird pool is " + fx(L.est, 3) + " " + ci(L.lo, L.hi, 3) + " with I² = " + fx(L.I2, 2) + ".") : "Select at least one held-out group. The pooled rows always show: d₀ = " + fx(P.est, 3) + " " + ci(P.lo, P.hi, 3) + ".";
}

/* ================= ENTRY BROWSER ================= */
const SU = {PHYS: "Physical Sciences", LIFEENV: "Life & Environment", SOC: "Social Sciences", MATHDEC: "Math & Decision", COHORT_DEVHOME: "2010–14 cohort, DEV homes", COHORT_NONDEVHOME: "2010–14 cohort, other homes"};
const SC = ST.cols, sI = n => SC.indexOf(n);
const S = {f: sI("field"), phi: sI("a_phi_home"), sz: sI("b_log_size"), d0: sI("d0_ret_rel"), nret: sI("n_ret"), p2: sI("p_R2"), p3: sI("p_R3"), y: sI("entered")};
function rankOf(c, i, col){ let k = 1; c.forEach((x, j) => { if (j !== i && x[col] > c[i][col]) k++; }); return k; }
ST.strata.forEach(s => { const i = s.c.findIndex(x => x[S.y] === 1); s.ei = i; s.rk2 = rankOf(s.c, i, S.p2); s.rk3 = rankOf(s.c, i, S.p3); });
Object.keys(SU).forEach(u => { const o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = u; o.textContent = SU[u]; $("#sb-unit").appendChild(o); });
function fillSets(){
  const u = $("#sb-unit").value, flip = $("#sb-flip").checked, sel = $("#sb-set"); sel.innerHTML = "";
  const list = ST.strata.map((s, i) => ({s: s, i: i})).filter(o => o.s.unit === u && (!flip || o.s.rk3 < o.s.rk2));
  list.forEach(o => { const op = document.createElement("option"); op.value = o.i; op.textContent = o.s.concept + ", " + o.s.year; sel.appendChild(op); });
  drawSet();
}
function drawSet(){
  const sel = $("#sb-set");
  if (!sel.value){ $("#sb-sbs").innerHTML = "<p class='muted'>No embedded risk set in this unit matches the filter.</p>"; $("#c-strata").innerHTML = ""; $("#t-strata").textContent = "No set matches; clear the filter to see all 30."; return; }
  const s = ST.strata[+sel.value], F = ST.fields;
  const ent = s.c.filter(x => x[S.y] === 1).map(x => F[x[S.f]]);
  $("#sb-sbs").innerHTML = "<div class='cell'><h4>Input</h4><strong>" + esc(s.concept) + "</strong>, " + s.year + "<br>home field: " + esc(s.home || "n/a") + "<br>" + s.c.length + " candidate fields; retains " + s.c[0][S.nret] + " off-home field" + (s.c[0][S.nret] === 1 ? "" : "s") + "</div>" +
    "<div class='cell'><h4>Baseline R2</h4>entered field ranked <strong>" + s.rk2 + "</strong> of " + s.c.length + "<br>p = " + fx(s.c[s.ei][S.p2], 3) + "</div>" +
    "<div class='cell'><h4>With retained frontier R3</h4>entered field ranked <strong>" + s.rk3 + "</strong> of " + s.c.length + "<br>p = " + fx(s.c[s.ei][S.p3], 3) + "</div>";
  const sorted = s.c.slice().sort((a, b) => b[S.p3] - a[S.p3]);
  let show = sorted.slice(0, 10); sorted.forEach(x => { if (x[S.y] === 1 && show.indexOf(x) < 0) show.push(x); });
  hbars($("#c-strata"), {cats: show.map(x => ({label: (x[S.y] ? "▸ " : "") + F[x[S.f]].replace(", Genetics and Molecular Biology", ", Gen. & Mol. Biol.").replace("Economics, Econometrics and Finance", "Economics & Finance").replace("Pharmacology, Toxicology and Pharmaceutics", "Pharmacology & Tox.").replace("Business, Management and Accounting", "Business & Mgmt").replace("Agricultural and Biological Sciences", "Agri. & Biol. Sciences") + (x[S.y] ? " (entered)" : ""), bold: x[S.y] === 1,
      vals: [{v: x[S.p2], text: fx(x[S.p2], 3), color: "var(--base)", tip: "<strong>" + esc(F[x[S.f]]) + "</strong><br>R2 probability " + fx(x[S.p2], 4) + "<br>relatedness to home " + fx(x[S.phi], 3) + ", log size " + fx(x[S.sz], 2) + ", retained-field relatedness " + fx(x[S.d0], 3), aria: F[x[S.f]] + " R2 " + fx(x[S.p2], 3)},
             {v: x[S.p3], text: fx(x[S.p3], 3), color: "var(--accent)", tip: "<strong>" + esc(F[x[S.f]]) + "</strong><br>R3 probability " + fx(x[S.p3], 4) + "<br>retained-field relatedness " + fx(x[S.d0], 3) + (x[S.y] ? "<br>entered this year" : ""), aria: F[x[S.f]] + " R3 " + fx(x[S.p3], 3)}]})),
    xTitle: "Within-set choice probability", barH: 11, aria: "Candidate field probabilities under R2 and R3"});
  const d = s.rk2 - s.rk3;
  $("#t-strata").textContent = esc(s.concept) + " entered " + ent.join(" and ") + " in " + s.year + ". " + (d > 0 ? "Adding retained-field relatedness moves that field up " + d + " place" + (d === 1 ? "" : "s") + " (rank " + s.rk2 + " → " + s.rk3 + ")." : d < 0 ? "Here R3 ranks it lower than the baseline (rank " + s.rk2 + " → " + s.rk3 + "): the retained frontier points elsewhere." : "Both models rank it " + s.rk2 + "; the retained frontier changes nothing for this decision.");
}
$("#sb-unit").addEventListener("change", fillSets); $("#sb-flip").addEventListener("change", fillSets); $("#sb-set").addEventListener("change", drawSet);

/* ================= TOP-K ================= */
const EU = EVT.units, ER = EVT.rows;
const TK = [{lab: "All held-out groups", f: u => u <= 3}, {lab: "Physical Sciences", f: u => u === 0}, {lab: "Life & Environment", f: u => u === 1}, {lab: "Social Sciences", f: u => u === 2}, {lab: "Math & Decision", f: u => u === 3}, {lab: "2010–14 cohort", f: u => u >= 4}];
function drawTopk(){
  const k = +$("#tk-k").value; $("#tk-kv").textContent = k;
  const cats = TK.map((t, i) => { const ev = ER.filter(r => t.f(r[0])); const h2 = ev.filter(r => r[1] <= k).length / ev.length, h3 = ev.filter(r => r[2] <= k).length / ev.length; t.h2 = h2; t.h3 = h3; t.n = ev.length;
    return {label: t.lab, bold: i === 0, vals: [
      {v: h2 * 100, text: pct(h2), color: "var(--base)", tip: "<strong>" + t.lab + "</strong><br>R2: entered field in top " + k + " for " + pct(h2) + " of " + ev.length.toLocaleString("en-US") + " events", aria: t.lab + " R2 " + pct(h2)},
      {v: h3 * 100, text: pct(h3), color: "var(--accent)", tip: "<strong>" + t.lab + "</strong><br>R3: entered field in top " + k + " for " + pct(h3) + " of " + ev.length.toLocaleString("en-US") + " events", aria: t.lab + " R3 " + pct(h3)}]}; });
  hbars($("#c-topk"), {cats: cats, xTitle: "Entry events whose entered field is in the model's top " + k + " (%)", domain: [0, 100], barH: 13, aria: "Top-k hit rates", tickFmt: v => v.toFixed(0)});
  const a = TK[0], m = TK[4];
  $("#t-topk").textContent = "With " + k + " guess" + (k === 1 ? "" : "es") + ", the R2 baseline names the entered field for " + pct(a.h2) + " of " + a.n.toLocaleString("en-US") + " held-out events and R3 for " + pct(a.h3) + " (" + fx((a.h3 - a.h2) * 100, 1, true) + " points). In Math & Decision the gain is " + fx((m.h3 - m.h2) * 100, 1, true) + " points. The retained frontier is a real but small addition to a baseline dominated by field size.";
}
$("#tk-k").addEventListener("input", drawTopk);

/* ================= CALCULATOR ================= */
let calcVals = [];
function loadCalc(){
  const r = ROWS[br.sel].r; calcVals = COMPS.map(c => r[c.i]);
  $("#calc-name").innerHTML = "Concept: <strong>" + esc(r[I.name]) + "</strong> (recorded OPEN<sub>home</sub> " + fx(r[I.open], 3, true) + "). Select another in the concept browser to load it.";
  const box = $("#calc-sliders"); box.innerHTML = "";
  COMPS.forEach((c, j) => {
    const k = K[c.k], id = "cs-" + j, v = calcVals[j];
    const row = document.createElement("div"); row.className = "slrow";
    const step = c.k === "n_comm_W3" ? 1 : +((k.hi - k.lo) / 200).toPrecision(2);
    row.innerHTML = "<label for='" + id + "'>" + esc(c.lab) + (k.sign < 0 ? " (counts against)" : "") + "</label><output id='" + id + "-o' for='" + id + "'></output><input type='range' id='" + id + "' min='" + k.lo + "' max='" + k.hi + "' step='" + step + "'" + (v === null ? " disabled" : "") + ">";
    box.appendChild(row);
    const inp = row.querySelector("input"), out = row.querySelector("output");
    inp.value = v === null ? k.lo : Math.min(Math.max(v, k.lo), k.hi);
    out.textContent = v === null ? "undefined" : fx(v, 3);
    inp.addEventListener("input", () => { calcVals[j] = +inp.value; out.textContent = fx(+inp.value, 3); drawCalc(); });
  });
  drawCalc();
}
function drawCalc(){
  const r = ROWS[br.sel].r, o = openOf(calcVals);
  const cats = COMPS.map((c, j) => { if (calcVals[j] === null) return {label: c.lab, vals: [{v: 0, text: "undefined", color: "var(--base)", tip: esc(c.lab) + " is not defined for this concept and is left out of the mean", aria: c.lab + " undefined"}]};
    const z = zOf(c, calcVals[j]); const k = K[c.k];
    return {label: c.lab, vals: [{v: z, text: fx(z, 2, true), color: k.sign > 0 ? "var(--accent)" : "var(--warn)", tip: "<strong>" + esc(c.lab) + "</strong><br>raw " + fx(calcVals[j], 3) + ", clipped to [" + fx(k.lo, 3) + ", " + fx(k.hi, 3) + "]<br>z = " + (k.sign < 0 ? "−" : "") + "(x − " + fx(k.mu, 3) + ") / " + fx(k.sd, 3) + " = " + fx(z, 3, true), aria: c.lab + " signed z " + fx(z, 2, true)}]}; });
  hbars($("#c-calc"), {cats: cats, xTitle: "Signed z-score (frozen DEV constants)", barH: 16, aria: "Signed component z-scores"});
  const same = COMPS.every((c, j) => calcVals[j] === r[c.i]);
  $("#calc-out").innerHTML = "OPEN<sub>home</sub> = mean of " + calcVals.filter(v => v !== null).length + " signed z-scores = <strong>" + fx(o, 3, true) + "</strong> (" + pct(pctRank(o), 0) + " percentile). " + (same ? (Math.abs(o - r[I.open]) < 5e-4 ? "<span class='pill ok'>matches the recorded " + fx(r[I.open], 3, true) + "</span>" : "<span class='pill bad'>differs from recorded " + fx(r[I.open], 3, true) + "</span>") : "<span class='pill'>edited; recorded " + fx(r[I.open], 3, true) + "</span>");
  const big = cats.map((c, j) => ({c: COMPS[j].lab, z: calcVals[j] === null ? 0 : zOf(COMPS[j], calcVals[j])})).sort((a, b) => Math.abs(b.z) - Math.abs(a.z))[0];
  $("#t-calc").textContent = (same ? "Recorded values for " + r[I.name] : "Edited values") + ": OPEN home = " + fx(o, 3, true) + ". The largest single contribution comes from " + big.c.toLowerCase() + " (" + fx(big.z, 2, true) + "), so one component can move the index by a sixth of its z-score.";
}
$("#calc-reset").addEventListener("click", loadCalc);

/* ================= STEPPER ================= */
const G = ROWS.find(o => o.r[I.name] === "Graphics processing unit").r;
const gz = COMPS.map(c => G[c.i] === null ? null : zOf(c, G[c.i]));
const gOpen = openOf(COMPS.map(c => G[c.i]));
const PO = EV.pools["OPEN_home|R2"], DEVR = EV.rows.find(r => r.body === "B1_DEV" && r.feature === "OPEN_home").R2;
const STAGES = [
  {short: "Ground", title: "1. Ground the concept and date its onset",
   in_: "OpenAlex snapshot (476M works); the legacy concept “Graphics processing unit” and its aliases.",
   do_: "Aho–Corasick title matching with stemmed verification and an LLM precision gate; <button class='term' data-term='t0'>onset year</button> = first year with 20 grounded papers; <button class='term' data-term='home'>home field</button> = field holding at least 40% of the first 30 papers.",
   out: "t<sub>0</sub> = <strong>" + G[I.t0] + "</strong>, home group " + esc(G[I.agroup]) + " (Engineering), body " + esc(BODY_LAB[G[I.body]]) + "; <strong>" + G[I.nh] + "</strong> home-field papers in " + G[I.t0] + "–" + (G[I.t0] + 2) + ".",
   why: "Every later quantity is measured relative to onset, so the early window never overlaps the outcome window (t<sub>0</sub>+6 to t<sub>0</sub>+8)."},
  {short: "Ego network", title: "2. Build the early home-field ego network",
   in_: "The " + G[I.nh] + " home-field papers of " + G[I.t0] + "–" + (G[I.t0] + 2) + " and the topic co-occurrence backbone.",
   do_: "Collect the concept's co-occurrence partner topics year by year and measure six properties of that neighbourhood.",
   out: COMPS.map(c => esc(c.lab) + " = <strong>" + fx(G[c.i], 3) + "</strong>").join("<br>"),
   why: "Openness means acquiring novel, community-spanning partners. GPU reaches " + fx(G[COMPS[1].i], 0) + " communities from home papers alone; with all papers (figure below) it has 34 topics in 8 communities."},
  {short: "Standardise", title: "3. Standardise with frozen DEV constants",
   in_: "The six raw components.",
   do_: "Clip each to frozen bounds, z-score with the frozen DEV mean and SD, and flip the sign of ego density and edge persistence.",
   out: COMPS.map((c, j) => esc(c.lab) + ": <strong>" + fx(gz[j], 2, true) + "</strong>").join("<br>"),
   why: "Constants were frozen on DEV before any held-out outcome was scored, so every body gets the same ruler."},
  {short: "Average", title: "4. Average into OPEN<sub>home</sub>",
   in_: "Six signed z-scores.",
   do_: "Take their mean (components that are undefined are dropped). Computed in your browser now.",
   out: "OPEN<sub>home</sub> = <strong>" + fx(gOpen, 3, true) + "</strong>; recorded " + fx(G[I.open], 3, true) + " (" + pct(pctRank(G[I.open]), 0) + " percentile of 7,748 concepts).",
   why: "Averaging six noisy components is what lets a small yearly sample carry a usable signal; split-half reliability of OPEN<sub>home</sub> is still only 0.49."},
  {short: "Baseline", title: "5. Set it beside the B5 popularity baseline",
   in_: "B5 for GPU: log early volume " + fx(CASE.gpu_B5.logvol, 2) + ", growth " + fx(CASE.gpu_B5.growth_c, 2) + ", non-home share " + fx(CASE.gpu_B5.offhome_share, 3) + ", entropy " + fx(CASE.gpu_B5.entropy, 2) + ", reach " + fx(CASE.gpu_B5.reach, 0) + ". By t<sub>0</sub>+2 GPU had entered " + CASE.E2[0] + " off-home fields.",
   do_: "Forecast rarefied breadth O<sub>2r</sub> (m = 50) from B5 alone and from B5 plus OPEN<sub>home</sub> (DEV-fitted OLS).",
   out: "B5: <strong>" + fx(G[I.b5], 2) + "</strong>; B5 + OPEN: <strong>" + fx(G[I.b5o], 2) + "</strong>; observed: <strong>" + fx(G[I.y], 2) + "</strong> fields.",
   why: "For one concept the OPEN term moves the forecast by " + fx(G[I.b5o] - G[I.b5], 3) + " fields. The index is not a forecasting tool; its evidence is a population-level association."},
  {short: "Pool", title: "6. Score across concepts and pool across bodies",
   in_: "OPEN<sub>home</sub>, O<sub>2r</sub> and the R2 controls for every concept in each body.",
   do_: "Partial Spearman: rank both, residualise on B5 and the rung's controls, correlate; 2,000 concept bootstraps; DerSimonian–Laird pool over non-selection bodies.",
   out: "DEV (selection): " + fx(DEVR.psp, 3, true) + " " + ci(DEVR.lo, DEVR.hi, 3, true) + "; pool of " + PO.k + " non-selection bodies: <strong>" + fx(PO.est, 3, true) + " " + ci(PO.lo, PO.hi, 3, true) + "</strong>.",
   why: "The selection body is " + fx(PO.shrink, 2) + "× the pool: choosing an index on DEV inflates its DEV estimate, which is why only non-selection bodies are pooled."}];
let stage = 0;
const sl = $("#stage-list");
STAGES.forEach((s, i) => { const li = document.createElement("li"); const b = document.createElement("button"); b.type = "button"; b.innerHTML = (i + 1) + ". " + s.short; b.addEventListener("click", () => go(i)); li.appendChild(b); sl.appendChild(li); });
function drawPipeline(){
  const box = $("#c-pipeline"); box.innerHTML = "";
  const W = Math.max(300, box.clientWidth), cols = W < 620 ? 3 : 6, rowsN = 6 / cols, bw = (W - (cols - 1) * 22) / cols, bh = 46, H = rowsN * bh + (rowsN - 1) * 18 + 4;
  const svg = el("svg", {viewBox: "0 0 " + W + " " + H, width: W, height: H}, box);
  STAGES.forEach((s, i) => { const c = i % cols, r = Math.floor(i / cols), x = c * (bw + 22), y = 2 + r * (bh + 18);
    const on = i === stage, done = i < stage;
    el("rect", {x: x, y: y, width: bw, height: bh, rx: 8, fill: on ? "var(--accent)" : done ? "var(--accent-soft)" : "#fff", stroke: on || done ? "var(--accent)" : "#c9ced4", "stroke-width": 1.5}, svg);
    const t = txt(svg, x + bw / 2, y + bh / 2 + 5, (i + 1) + " " + s.short, {"text-anchor": "middle", "font-size": 13.5, "font-weight": on ? 700 : 500, fill: on ? "#fff" : "var(--ink)"});
    t.style.fill = on ? "#fff" : "";
    if (c < cols - 1 && i < 5) el("path", {d: "M" + (x + bw + 4) + " " + (y + bh / 2) + " l12 0 m-5 -5 l5 5 l-5 5", stroke: "#8e98a4", fill: "none", "stroke-width": 1.6}, svg);
  });
}
function go(i){
  stage = Math.max(0, Math.min(STAGES.length - 1, i));
  const s = STAGES[stage];
  $("#stage-panel").innerHTML = "<h4 style='font-size:1.1rem;margin:0 0 10px'>" + s.title + "</h4><div class='stagebody'><div class='cell'><h4>What goes in</h4>" + s.in_ + "</div><div class='cell'><h4>What is done</h4>" + s.do_ + "</div><div class='cell'><h4>What comes out</h4>" + s.out + "</div></div><p class='why' style='margin-top:10px'><strong>Why:</strong> " + s.why + "</p>";
  sl.querySelectorAll("button").forEach((b, j) => { if (j === stage) b.setAttribute("aria-current", "step"); else b.removeAttribute("aria-current"); });
  $("#st-prev").disabled = stage === 0; $("#st-next").disabled = stage === STAGES.length - 1;
  $("#st-live").textContent = "Stage " + (stage + 1) + " of " + STAGES.length + ": " + s.title.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "");
  $("#t-step").innerHTML = ["GPU has an Engineering home and an onset in 2008, one of 3,169 DEV concepts in this set.",
    "GPU's home neighbourhood is dense (ego density " + fx(G[COMPS[4].i], 2) + ") but it adds new partners quickly (new edge rate " + fx(G[COMPS[0].i], 2) + ").",
    "New edge rate (" + fx(gz[0], 2, true) + ") and novelty (" + fx(gz[3], 2, true) + ") push GPU's openness up; density and persistence pull slightly down.",
    "GPU ends above most concepts on OPEN<sub>home</sub>: " + pct(pctRank(G[I.open]), 0) + " percentile.",
    "GPU spreads widely, yet it lands " + fx(G[I.y] - G[I.b5], 2, true) + " fields from its B5 forecast: single concepts do not follow the pooled trend.",
    "Across bodies the association is small and positive: " + fx(PO.est, 3, true) + " " + ci(PO.lo, PO.hi, 3, true) + "."][stage];
  bindTerms($("#stage-panel"));
  drawPipeline();
}
$("#st-prev").addEventListener("click", () => go(stage - 1));
$("#st-next").addEventListener("click", () => go(stage + 1));
$("#stepper").addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.target.tagName === "INPUT" || e.target.tagName === "SELECT") return; if (e.key === "ArrowRight"){ e.preventDefault(); go(stage + 1); } if (e.key === "ArrowLeft"){ e.preventDefault(); go(stage - 1); } });

/* ================= ROBUSTNESS / FAILS ================= */
let rbTab = "fail";
function drawRobust(){
  const P = EN.pooled; let rows = [], s = "";
  if (rbTab === "fail"){
    const vm = EN.fails.find(f => f.id === "volmatch"), mc = EN.fails.find(f => f.id === "mincp");
    rows = [{label: "Primary held-out d₀ (PMI backbone)", est: P.est, lo: P.lo, hi: P.hi, kind: "body", shape: "circle", valText: fx(P.est, 3) + " " + ci(P.lo, P.hi, 3), tip: "<strong>Primary held-out estimate</strong><br>" + fx(P.est, 3) + " " + ci(P.lo, P.hi, 3)},
      {label: "Volume-matched contrast", est: vm.est, lo: vm.lo, hi: vm.hi, kind: "body", color: "var(--warn)", shape: "circle", valText: fx(vm.est, 3) + " " + ci(vm.lo, vm.hi, 3), tip: "<strong>Volume-matched contrast</strong><br>retained vs entered-but-not-retained fields in the same volume cell<br>" + fx(vm.est, 3) + " " + ci(vm.lo, vm.hi, 3) + ", one-sided p = " + fx(vm.p, 2)},
      {label: "d₀ under min-cond.-prob. proximity", est: mc.est, kind: "body", color: "var(--warn)", shape: "circle", valText: fx(mc.est, 3) + " (p = " + fx(mc.p, 3) + ")", tip: "<strong>Hidalgo minimum-conditional-probability proximity</strong><br>d₀ = " + fx(mc.est, 3) + ", p = " + fx(mc.p, 3) + "<br>RCA density becomes strong: LR " + fx(mc.rca_LR, 0)}];
    s = "Two tests break the claim. The pre-registered volume-matched contrast is null (" + fx(vm.est, 3) + " " + ci(vm.lo, vm.hi, 3) + "), and under minimum-conditional-probability proximity d₀ = " + fx(mc.est, 3) + " (p = " + fx(mc.p, 3) + ") while RCA density becomes strong (LR " + fx(mc.rca_LR, 0) + "). Verdict: PARTIAL, persistence confounded with volume.";
  } else if (rbTab === "dose"){
    rows = EN.fails.filter(f => f.group === "dose").map(f => ({label: f.label.replace("Dose: ", ""), est: f.est, kind: "body", shape: "circle", valText: fx(f.est, 3), tip: "<strong>" + esc(f.label) + "</strong><br>coefficient " + fx(f.est, 3)}));
    const d = EN.fails.filter(f => f.group === "dose");
    s = "By retention age the coefficients are " + d.map(f => fx(f.est, 3)).join(" / ") + ": not monotone. Only long-retained fields carry a large coefficient, which is also where volume is largest.";
  } else {
    rows = EN.robust.map(f => ({label: f.label, est: f.est, kind: f.id === "primary" ? "pool" : "body", shape: "circle", valText: fx(f.est, 3), tip: "<strong>" + esc(f.label) + "</strong><br>d₀ = " + fx(f.est, 3)}));
    const v = EN.robust.map(f => f.est);
    s = "Across " + (EN.robust.length - 1) + " robustness variants d₀ stays between " + fx(Math.min.apply(null, v), 3) + " and " + fx(Math.max.apply(null, v), 3) + ". These variants keep the PMI backbone and do not address the volume confound.";
  }
  forest($("#c-robust"), {rows: rows, values: true, ref: P.est, xTitle: "Coefficient (log-odds per SD)", aria: "Entry-model tests"});
  $("#c-robust").setAttribute("aria-labelledby", "rb-tab-" + rbTab);
  $("#t-robust").textContent = s;
}
radioGroup($("#rb-tabs"), v => { rbTab = v; drawRobust(); }, "aria-selected");

/* ---------- confound ---------- */
const CFL = {NOVCHURN_raw: ["Raw NOVCHURN", "var(--base)"], NOVCHURN_exc: ["Excess over permutation null (V2)", "var(--warn)"], NOVCHURN_zperm: ["z against permutation null (V2)", "var(--warn)"],
  NOVCHURN_rare5: ["Rarefied to 5 papers/yr (V1)", "var(--accent)"], NOVCHURN_rare10: ["Rarefied to 10 papers/yr (V1)", "var(--accent)"], NOVCHURN_cfg: ["Configuration-null z (V3)", "var(--accent)"], NOVCHURN_chao: ["Chao-corrected persistence", "var(--accent)"]};
function drawConf(){
  const body = $("#cf-body").value;
  const vs = CF.variants.filter(v => CFL[v.variant] && v[body]);
  const rows = vs.map(v => ({label: CFL[v.variant][0], est: v[body].psp, lo: v[body].lo, hi: v[body].hi, kind: "body", color: CFL[v.variant][1], valText: fx(v[body].psp, 3, true) + " " + ci(v[body].lo, v[body].hi, 3, true),
    tip: "<strong>" + esc(CFL[v.variant][0]) + "</strong><br>PSP " + fx(v[body].psp, 3, true) + " " + ci(v[body].lo, v[body].hi, 3, true) + "<br>n = " + v[body].n.toLocaleString("en-US")}));
  const raw = CF.variants.find(v => v.variant === "NOVCHURN_raw")[body];
  forest($("#c-conf"), {rows: rows, values: true, ref: raw ? raw.psp : undefined, xTitle: "Partial Spearman with O₂r (m = 50), rung R2", aria: "NOVCHURN variants"});
  const exc = CF.variants.find(v => v.variant === "NOVCHURN_exc")[body], r10 = CF.variants.find(v => v.variant === "NOVCHURN_rare10")[body];
  $("#t-conf").textContent = (body === "POOLED" ? "Pooled" : BODY_LAB[body] || body) + ": raw NOVCHURN " + fx(raw.psp, 3, true) + "; the excess over the within-concept permutation null falls to " + fx(exc.psp, 3, true) + " " + ci(exc.lo, exc.hi, 3, true) + (r10 ? ", while fixed-size rarefaction keeps " + fx(r10.psp, 3, true) : "") + ". What predicts breadth is a static property of the home-topic mix; the temporal-excess measure is too unreliable to settle whether churn itself matters.";
}
$("#cf-body").addEventListener("change", drawConf);

/* ---------- misses ---------- */
function drawMiss(){
  const t = $("#ms-table");
  let h = "<caption class='sr'>Misses by body</caption><thead><tr><th>Body</th><th class='num'>Concepts with outcome</th><th class='num'>Top-fifth OPEN below B5 forecast</th><th class='num'>Bottom-fifth OPEN above B5 forecast</th></tr></thead><tbody>";
  let tot = {n: 0, hi: 0, hin: 0, lo: 0, lon: 0};
  ["DEV", "OLDHO", "COH1014", "COH1517"].forEach(b => {
    const rows = CO.rows.filter(r => hasY(r) && r[I.body] === b), c = cutsByBody[b];
    const top = rows.filter(r => r[I.open] >= c[3]), bot = rows.filter(r => r[I.open] < c[0]);
    const mh = top.filter(r => r[I.y] < r[I.b5]).length, ml = bot.filter(r => r[I.y] > r[I.b5]).length;
    tot.n += rows.length; tot.hi += mh; tot.hin += top.length; tot.lo += ml; tot.lon += bot.length;
    h += "<tr><td>" + BODY_LAB[b] + "</td><td class='num'>" + rows.length.toLocaleString("en-US") + "</td><td class='num'>" + mh + " of " + top.length + " (" + pct(mh / top.length, 0) + ")</td><td class='num'>" + ml + " of " + bot.length + " (" + pct(ml / bot.length, 0) + ")</td></tr>";
  });
  t.innerHTML = h + "</tbody>";
  $("#t-miss").textContent = "Across bodies, " + pct(tot.hi / tot.hin, 0) + " of the most open concepts end up narrower than their popularity forecast, and " + pct(tot.lo / tot.lon, 0) + " of the least open end up broader. With a pooled correlation of +0.069, openness shifts the odds only slightly for any single concept.";
}
function showMisses(kind){ $("#br-filter").value = kind; $("#br-body").value = ""; $("#br-q").value = ""; $("#br-sort").value = kind === "miss-high" ? "open-desc" : "open-asc"; drawList(); loadCalc(); document.getElementById("v-browser").scrollIntoView({behavior: reduce ? "auto" : "smooth"}); $("#br-list").querySelector("button") && $("#br-list").querySelector("button").focus({preventScroll: true}); }
$("#ms-show-high").addEventListener("click", () => showMisses("miss-high"));
$("#ms-show-low").addEventListener("click", () => showMisses("miss-low"));

/* ================= TERMS ================= */
const TERMS = {
  cooc: ["Co-occurrence network", "The network of topics that appear on the same papers as the concept; the concept's ego network is its neighbour topics and the links among them."],
  b5: ["B5 baseline", "The five-feature popularity baseline: log early volume, publication growth, non-home share, Shannon entropy and field reach, all computed over t₀ to t₀+2."],
  openidx: ["OPEN index", "The mean of six signed z-scored ego-network components from the early window (t₀ to t₀+2); it measures a concept's early tendency to acquire novel, community-spanning co-occurrence partners."],
  openhome: ["OPEN home", "The OPEN index built from the home-field co-occurrence graph only; it is free of the mechanical coupling between off-home papers and the breadth outcome that inflates OPEN all."],
  psp: ["Partial Spearman priority (PSP)", "The Pearson correlation of rank-transformed indicator and outcome residuals, both residualised on the baseline covariates and control rungs."],
